speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have a dermatological condition with potential oncologic implications; please describe the lesions you are concerned about, including their size, color, shape, and how long they have been present.

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC).

The patient presents with non-healing, red, crusty lesions on the penis and finger, combined with a significant smoking history and failed prior treatments. I need to confirm the duration of these specific lesions and check for any regional lymphadenopathy.

REQUEST TEST: CBC, CRP, and HIV status.
REQUEST IMAGES: Photos of penile and digital lesions.
